resources.string: Talk wit AI for private, like phone call.
Show am when Puzru dey on
Puzru dey use notification wey no get sound to show say e dey on and ready to route audio, even when di app dey background. Notifications na choice; Puzru still dey work without dem.
Allow Mini make e show on top oda apps

Mini need Android access wey be “Display over other apps” so e go remain visible when you dey use voice app wey Puzru support. For di next screen, select Puzru from di app list and turn on dis access. Dis access na choice and e no allow Puzru read or control oda apps. Audio routing dey work without Mini.
Puzru Mini controller. Status: %1$s. Turn am on, expand, and close controls.

Puzru no need account or sign-in, and e no dey ask for microphone permission. E no dey capture or record microphone audio, and e no dey record or store your conversation or di audio content inside am.

Puzru dey use Android audio-system information wey e need for audio routing and diagnostics.

Diagnostic information dey generated and processed for your device, and e fit dey inside di local state of di app as e dey run. Reports no dey save or send by demself. To save report or hand am over to anoda app, you must do am by yourself with clear action.
To select lángwej inside app, you need Android 13 or later. Dis device dey follow system lángwej.
Off di screen when phone dey near ear

Puzru by Napahu Studios

Wetin di name mean
Di name Puzru come from one Akkadian word wey connect with to hide somtin or keep am secret. E show wetin di app dey try do: make e less likely say people wey dey near go hear supported AI voice playback.

Wetin Puzru dey do
Puzru dey help route supported AI voice playback go your phone built-in call earpiece, so you fit hear response more like normal phone call instead of make e play loud from di main loudspeaker.

Puzru dey use standard Android audio-routing function. Whether e go work depend on your device, Android version, and how each app or service dey handle voice audio.

Compatibility and limitations
• Voice features dey work different for different apps and services.
• Some voice modes fit need subscription, fit get region or account restriction, or fit no dey available at all.
• Puzru no dey unlock, extend, or bypass features wey third-party services provide.

Wetin Puzru no dey do
• E no dey make phone calls.
• E no dey operate, modify, or control third-party AI services.
• E no dey control speech recognition, di content or accuracy of AI responses, voice output, delay, network stability, or whether service dey available.
• E no dey give you privacy from di AI service itself. Puzru dey change where supported voice audio dey play for your device, no be how di AI service dey handle your conversation.
